## Question And Audience

**Audience:** Our target audience is public health students and health education professionals. We aim to help them understand differences in waist circumference across education levels among US adults through clear visualizations.

**Question:** How does mean waist circumference differ across education levels among adults aged 20–80?

**Why it matters:** This study matters because differences in mean waist circumference across education levels may reveal socioeconomic inequalities in health and help identify groups that could benefit from more accessible health education and preventive services.
